findings.title: Artifact count reaches 114 — exceeds 110 target
findings.description: Full buildout from 16 → 114 artifacts across all required categories: strategic docs, arch/ops docs, Cedar policies, runbooks, contracts, capabilities, dashboards, SLOs, IPs, catalog records, IaC.

findings.title: 11 catalog records added — all 6 BCs represented
findings.description: Catalog records: flag-kernel, flag-domain, flag-usecase, flag-adapter-postgres, flag-app, flag-rest, targeting-kernel, experiment-kernel, killswitch-kernel, rollout-kernel, metric-kernel. All follow ADR-0105 13-layer BNF v4.1 naming.

findings.title: IP-002 through IP-020 authored — 19 IPs total
findings.description: Full IP roster covering all 6 BCs: flag (IP-002..005), targeting (IP-006..007), experiment (IP-008..009, IP-020), killswitch (IP-010), rollout (IP-011), metric (IP-012), SDK layer (IP-013..016), IaC (IP-017), Cedar (IP-018), SLO wiring (IP-019).

findings.title: 9 Cedar policy fragments authored
findings.description: flag-mutation-authorization, experiment-design-authorization, safety-killswitch-authorization, pack-flag-override, pack-overlay-authorization, abuse-defence, auditor-scope, ci-scope, emergency-services-bypass. All include EMERGENCY_SERVICES bypass invariant per ADR-0298.

findings.title: OpenAPI 3.2.0, AsyncAPI 3.1.0, proto3, OpenFeature SDK contract authored
findings.description: openapi-v1.yaml (12 paths, OpenFeature resolution reasons, DSAR portability schema), asyncapi-v1.yaml (7 channels, HLC timestamps, EU AI Act Art.13 payload), feature-flags-v1.proto (4 services), openfeature-sdk-contract.md (caching contract, LKG 30-min).

findings.title: 4 SLOs in OpenSLO v1 format with burn-rate alerts
findings.description: flag-eval-latency (p99 ≤1ms, 99%), flag-state-propagation (≤5s, 99%), experiment-result-freshness (≤60s p95, 95%), killswitch-fire-latency (≤1s, 99.9% LIFE-SAFETY). All include fast-burn and slow-burn alert windows.

findings.title: Full IaC suite: K8s, Helm, OpenBao, Cilium, PQC, ECH, WAF, Terraform
findings.description: 8 IaC artifacts: k8s-deployment.yaml (kata-clh, SPIFFE, OpenBao sidecar), network-policy.yaml (CiliumNetworkPolicy default-deny), openbao-policy.hcl (max_ttl 60s all paths), secret-bindings.yaml (refreshInterval 55s), helm-values.yaml (HTTP/3+ECH+PQC), ech-config.yaml, pqc-cert.yaml (TLS 1.3 floor), edge-waf.yaml (EMERGENCY_SERVICES bypass first).

findings.title: Terraform main.tf added — OpenBao token TTL ≤60s enforced
findings.description: terraform/main.tf provisions K8s namespace, Helm release, OpenBao policy + auth backend role (token_ttl=60, token_max_ttl=60 per ADR-0296), Kafka topics (killswitch 50 partitions, flag-state 100 partitions), ClickHouse database + ReplicatedMergeTree table.

findings.title: Rust crate source files not yet scaffolded — design-ready only
findings.description: All IPs are in design-ready state. Actual Rust source (src/lib.rs per crate) not yet written. This is expected at PHASE-01 design-ready stage; implementation follows IP acceptance.
findings.recommendation: Scaffold Rust crates per IP-002..IP-012, IP-014, IP-020 in next build wave. Each crate needs Cargo.toml + src/lib.rs minimum.

findings.title: Cedar schema file (policy/schema.cedarschema) not yet authored
findings.description: Cedar fragments reference actions (FlagCreate, FlagUpdate, FlagArchive, FlagDelete, KillSwitchEngage, ExperimentActivate, PackOverrideApply, AuditRead, RolloutAdvance, RolloutRollback, FlagRead, FlagEvaluate) but the shared schema file is absent. cedar validate will fail without it.
findings.recommendation: Author policy/schema.cedarschema defining all entity types (Principal, Resource, Action) and Cedar context shapes. Required for IP-018 Definition of Done.

findings.title: EMERGENCY_SERVICES bypass propagated consistently across all layers
findings.description: EMERGENCY_SERVICES audience_type bypass is present in: ARCHITECTURE.md §critical-path-edge-cases, all 9 Cedar fragments, edge-waf.yaml (first rule), k8s-deployment.yaml annotations, capabilities/killswitch-trigger.yaml, runbooks/killswitch-engaged.md, IP-006, IP-010.

findings.title: Full statistical method suite: Bayesian + frequentist + mSPRT + SRM + Mann-Whitney-U + fairness
findings.description: IP-008, IP-020, PHASE-01, competitor-parity-matrix all document: Beta-Binomial Bayesian, frequentist z-test with Bonferroni, mSPRT sequential, Chi-squared SRM, Mann-Whitney-U, BH FDR, LIME/SHAP EU AI Act Art.13. Fairness audit ±2pp TPR/FPR per ADR-0309.
